input.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, warping, morphing subject, flicker, text, logo, watermark, low quality

vars.SUBJECT: a fictional, unbranded <product>: no logos, no badges, no text anywhere. <shape, materials, colour, the two or three details that make it recognisable>
vars.SET: <the place and its light>, cinematic campaign photography, ultra realistic, high detail
vars.SAME: Same exact subject (same design, same colour, same details), same set, same lighting and colour grade.
vars.STILL_CAMERA: The subject stays perfectly still; only the camera moves, smooth and steady, no cuts, no zoom jumps. Consistent lighting, photorealistic.

keys.prompt: Studio photograph of {SUBJECT}. Front three-quarter view from the left, 35mm lens, subject centred with generous space around it. {SET}.
{SAME} Same camera and framing. The set is almost completely dark: only a thin rim light traces the outline of the subject.
{SAME} Change only the camera: a pure side profile view, the whole subject centred in frame with space around it.

clips.prompt: The lights slowly rise until the subject is fully lit. Camera almost static, a very slow push-in. {STILL_CAMERA}
Slow cinematic camera orbit around the subject, from front three-quarter to pure side profile. {STILL_CAMERA}

keys.prompt: Same exact subject as in the reference images. <a new place, light and camera angle>, 16:9.

clips.prompt: <what moves and how the camera follows>. One continuous shot, no cuts, photorealistic.
